login.title: Sign in
login.forgotHint: Forgot your password? If you have no email, ask your admin for a new code and use “I have an invite code”.
login.missing: Enter your email or phone and your password.
login.notIdentifier: Enter an email address or phone number. Usernames no longer work.
login.expiredText: Sign in again. Your saved measurements are on this phone and will be sent after you sign in.

join.title: Invite code
join.lead: Enter the code from your admin and your phone number.
join.phoneInvalid: Enter your phone number with the area code.
join.codeIncomplete: The code has 8 characters. Check the code from your admin.
join.newLead: Check your name and choose a password.
join.name: Your name
join.existingLead: You already have an account with this phone. Enter your current password to join the company.
join.resetLead: An admin at {{org}} created a password code. Enter your new password. Other sessions on this account will end.
join.passwordShort: The password must have at least {{min}} characters.

org.title: Choose a company
org.lead: Which company are you working for? You can change this later on the Account screen.
org.emptyText: Your membership may have ended or been suspended. Contact your company admin.

account.title: Account
account.logoutPending_one: {{count}} measurement has not been sent. It stays on this phone and will be sent when you sign in again. Sign out?
account.logoutPending_other: {{count}} measurements have not been sent. They stay on this phone and will be sent when you sign in again. Sign out?
account.languagePending: Applied on this phone. It will be saved to your account when you are back online.
account.languageFailed: The language could not be saved. Try again.

others.samePerson: Saved under your other company. Sent when you switch to that company.
others.otherPerson: Saved on this phone with another account. Sent when its owner signs in.
others.both: Some are under your other company, some under another account. Sent when that session opens.
others.sectionTitle: Measurements from other sessions on this phone
others.sectionHint: These are sent when their owner signs in.
others.purgeConfirm_one: {{count}} measurement and its photos will be removed from this phone and never sent to the server. This cannot be undone. If the owner still works here, wait for them to sign in first.
others.purgeConfirm_other: {{count}} measurements and their photos will be removed from this phone and never sent to the server. This cannot be undone. If the owner still works here, wait for them to sign in first.
others.askAdmin_one: Ask your admin to delete {{count}} measurement.
others.askAdmin_other: Ask your admin to delete {{count}} measurements.
others.canDeleteHint_one: If the owner will not return to this phone, you can delete {{count}} measurement.
others.canDeleteHint_other: If the owner will not return to this phone, you can delete {{count}} measurements.

access.readOnlyText: The company's subscription is read only. New measurements cannot be saved, and queued ones stay on this phone. Contact your company admin.
access.noCaptureText: Your role does not allow measuring. You can still view measurements. Contact your company admin if you need access.
access.noToolTitle: You don't have access to this tool
access.noToolText: You have no {{product}} role at {{org}}, or the company doesn't use this tool. Contact your company admin.

profile.failedText: Check your internet connection and try again.

errors.NETWORK: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection and the server address.
errors.TIMEOUT: The server did not respond. Try again shortly.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email, phone or password is incorrect.
errors.WRONG_CURRENT_PASSWORD: Your current password is incorrect. The number of attempts is limited.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.INVITE_INVALID: The code is not valid or has expired. Check the phone and the code, or ask your admin for a new one.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: You are already a member of this company. Sign in with your password.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Your email is not verified. We have sent you a new verification link.
errors.AUTH_UNAVAILABLE: Your session cannot be verified right now. Try again in a few seconds. Your measurements are safe on this phone.
errors.DB_UNAVAILABLE: The server is busy. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.SERVER: Something went wrong on the server. Try again shortly.
errors.VALIDATION: Some details are not valid. Check the fields.
errors.INVALID_PHONE: The phone number is not valid. Include the area code.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: The password must be at least {{min}} characters and must not be a commonly used one.
errors.ORG_NOT_FOUND: You no longer have access to this company. Refresh the list.

webPanel.a11y: Admin panel, opens in the browser
